name: vmix-reference-studio
description: Search images, YouTube, song lyrics and trusted sources, and send them live to vMix over NDI. For Windows and macOS.

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && node scripts/verify-build.mjs
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
scripts.package: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.package:mac: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --mac --publish never
scripts.package:dir: npm run build && node scripts/clean-release.mjs && electron-builder --dir --publish never
scripts.release: npm run release:check && npm run build && electron-builder --publish always
